name: Bracket vote
use_when: ranking or settling 'best X' among 4 to 8 entries head to head
dont_use_when: a quick pick among 2-3 options (use poll)
guarantees: no one votes for both sides of a match
each round is exactly the winners of the last one
a winner had at least as many votes; ties go to the server seed, shown once confirmed
only the newest round is open; a leaver's votes in open matches go, a late joiner can vote
